methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents intentional capability-building outside metro hubs, creating distributed learning infrastructure that could seed peer-to-peer AI fluency in underserved regions if sustained beyond initial launch.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA explicitly targets community-level AI education and innovation, signaling institutional investment in broad-based capability development rather than elite concentration, though execution will determine depth of adoption.

signals.title: Virginia Beach schools bring ChatGPT under division oversight as AI use grows - 13newsnow.com
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Beach schools bringing ChatGPT under division oversight indicates platform-delivered AI creating shallow but distributed adoption—students gain access to tools without necessarily building deep technical understanding or fluency.

signals.title: Norfolk could get AI assist for non-emergency calls - WAVY.com
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk's AI dispatcher for non-emergency calls exemplifies platform-based automation delivering efficiency gains without requiring deep local AI capability—distribution through vendor solutions rather than indigenous expertise.

signals.title: Emerald AI reaches unicorn status with $1.05B valuation - Virginia Business
signals.signal_reading: Emerald AI achieving unicorn status in NoVA reinforces the region's role as Virginia's AI capital concentration zone, attracting talent and investment that deepens metro-rural capability gaps unless deliberate knowledge distribution mechanisms emerge.
